sources.name: ICRISAT District Level Database
sources.organization: International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics (ICRISAT)
sources.usage: Historical district-level yields and crop area/production; the supplied wide-format export is reshaped using its documented units.

sources.name: District-wise, season-wise crop production statistics
sources.organization: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Directorate of Economics and Statistics
sources.usage: Official district, crop, season, year, area, production, and yield observations when a source file is supplied.

sources.name: NASA POWER Daily Point
sources.usage: Observed precipitation, temperature, humidity, and solar radiation for user-supplied district-season periods and coordinates.

sources.name: SoilGrids
sources.usage: Optional soil information; no district-level soil values are currently integrated.
